Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Rustic Reclaimed Elm Round Accent Side End Table, 16.9"W, Natural
Colors: Ash
Materials: Elm wood
Touches of modern and rustic intersect in this beautifully crafted side table. Uniform, reclaimed elm wood throughout the piece gives the appearance of being carved out of a single log. Its compact size makes it ideal for placing in tight spaces. 16.9"Diameter x 18.1"H Entire piece is made of reclaimed elm Modern design with a touch of rustic, thanks to reclaimed elm with an unfinished look A beautifully simple table compact enough to fit small spaces No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
